source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: How can you directly change the behavior specified by an existing skill?

options.text: Edit its instructions and test the revised procedure
options.feedback: You can revise the document yourself, then inspect results to see whether the change helped.

options.text: Retrain the model before changing the procedure
options.feedback: A skill is editable guidance. Changing its instructions does not require changing the model through training.

options.text: Rename the output without changing the instructions
options.feedback: Changing an output name does not revise the procedure that produces it.

options.text: Correct one generated answer without updating the saved skill
options.feedback: Repairing one output can improve that artifact, but it does not change the reusable instructions that govern later runs.
